blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Makabayan bloc has warned that the version of the proposed antidynasty bill pending in Congress does not abide by the Supreme Court directive to prohibit relatives from holding public office simultaneously. While it welcomed the Supreme Court ruling that compelled the legislature to pass an enabling law that would finally put a blanket ban on political dynasties, Makabayan expressed alarm that the current version of the bill does not prohibit, but merely aims to regulate, if not legitimize. “A measure that merely limits the number of family members who may simultaneously hold office does not dismantle dynastic […]...
